rv.q: Goldfiner’s one-act drama is a sweet story about how we all have a similar need for love and forgiveness.
The world premiere performance of Jacqueline Goldfinger’s “Bottle Fly” is good but not as powerful as it could have been.

cn.t: Goldfinger's Everglades-set drama earns praise for its powerful performances and layered exploration of queer survival amid race, poverty, and bigotry in South Florida, with standout work from the ensemble cast.
